Privacy Notice & Data Processing Consent

By submitting your application and uploading your resume/CV, you acknowledge and agree that Xsolla will process your personal information (including but not limited to your name, contact details, work experience, and educational background) for the purpose of recruitment, candidate evaluation, and internal record-keeping.

In accordance with the Personal Information Protection Law of the People's Republic of China (中华人民共和国个人信息保护法 — PIPL):

Purpose Limitation: Your data will only be used for current and future recruitment considerations within Xsolla.

Sensitivity: We will handle your personal information with a high duty of care.

Your Rights: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information, and to withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us.

If your application proceeds past the final interview stage, we may conduct a background check, subject to applicable laws and regulations, only after obtaining your separate written consent. Any such check will be strictly limited to information directly relevant to the employment relationship (e.g., educational background, employment history) and will comply fully with the PIPL. Your personal information will be used solely for recruitment and human resource management purposes, and we will implement rigorous security measures to protect your data.

Xsolla takes your privacy rights seriously. We are committed to protecting your personal information in accordance with Chinese data protection laws, including the PIPL, the Cybersecurity Law (网络安全法), and the Data Security Law (数据安全法), and will not sell, unlawfully provide, or disclose any personal data received during the hiring process without your explicit authorization. As a data processor, we uphold our obligations to safeguard your personal data and respect your privacy.

For any inquiries related to data privacy, please contact: careers@xsolla.com
description:
ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

 

 

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for an Account Executive — Gaming/Adtech Sales who is relationship-driven, commercially sharp, and deeply immersed in China's gaming and digital advertising ecosystem to join our Revenue & Partnerships team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to own the full sales cycle — from prospecting and pitching through to close — across a diverse book of gaming advertisers and publishers across China and the broader APAC market.

Strong commercial acumen and communication skills are essential, along with experience in digital advertising sales, performance marketing, or gaming monetization within the Chinese market. The ability to build enduring client relationships grounded in trust, navigate China's complex and fast-moving digital advertising landscape, and manage multi-stakeholder deal structures will be key to your success in this role.

If you're passionate about the intersection of gaming and advertising technology and love building innovative ad solutions that help game developers grow their player base and revenue across the world's largest gaming market, we would love to hear from you!

lists.content:
Responsibilities:

  • Own the full sales cycle for gaming ad sales accounts across China and the APAC region — from prospecting and outreach through pitch, negotiation, and close, with a strong focus on relationship cultivation consistent with Chinese business practices

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based, long-term relationships with game developers, publishers, and advertising agencies, acting as the primary point of contact for Xsolla's ad monetization solutions in the Chinese market

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities by leveraging existing networks, attending industry events, and proactively targeting key accounts within China's gaming and advertising ecosystem

  • Develop tailored account plans and pitch materials that align client goals with Xsolla's product offerings, including offerwall, rewarded ads, and performance-based monetization tools, localized appropriately for the Chinese market

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with global product, marketing, and partner success teams to ensure client campaigns are delivered effectively and meet performance targets

  • Monitor campaign performance, provide clients with regular reporting and insights in both Mandarin and English, and proactively recommend optimizations to maximize results and retention

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all sales activities, pipeline status, and account details in CRM (Salesforce)

  • Represent Xsolla at key gaming and ad tech conferences and trade events across China and APAC (e.g., China Joy, Game Connection Asia, Pocket Gamer Connects, WePlay Expo)

  • Provide market intelligence on advertiser trends, competitor activity, platform developments, and emerging opportunities across China's gaming and digital advertising markets

    •  

     

    Qualifications and Skills:

    • 3+ years of experience in digital advertising sales, ad tech, gaming monetization, or a closely related field within the Chinese market

    • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and managing a full sales cycle, including experience navigating China's relationship-driven (guanxi-based) enterprise sales environment

    • Strong understanding of performance advertising models (CPI, CPA, CPM) and the mobile gaming ecosystem, with familiarity with China's major publishers and platforms (Tencent, NetEase, miHoYo, ByteDance/TikTok, Bilibili, Kuaishou, Baidu)

    • Native or business-level proficiency in Mandarin Chinese, with strong working proficiency in English — the ability to operate fluently across both languages in client-facing and internal communications is essential

    • Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills with a strong understanding of Chinese business culture, including relationship-building norms, hierarchy, and enterprise decision-making dynamics

    • Proficiency in CRM software (Salesforce preferred) and standard sales tooling, as well as familiarity with Chinese business communication platforms (WeChat, DingTalk)

    • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts simultaneously and adapt quickly to China's rapidly evolving regulatory and platform environment

    • Based in or willing to relocate to Beijing, China; eligible to work in China without visa sponsorship

      •  

       

      Nice to Have:

      • Experience working with offerwall, rewarded video, or user acquisition advertising products within the Chinese mobile gaming space

      • Established network within China's games industry — publishers, studios, ad agencies, or platform partners (WeChat Mini Games, Douyin, Kuaishou, Huawei AppGallery, TapTap)

      • Familiarity with mobile game monetization metrics (ARPU, LTV, ROAS, D7/D30 retention) and China-specific monetization trends such as gacha mechanics, battle pass models, and live-service content strategies

        •

ABOUT YOU
We are seeking a hands-on and forward-thinking AI Engineer to help build and operate the intelligent systems that power Xsolla's infrastructure. As part of our Infrastructure Team, you will implement AI-driven solutions across cloud optimization, security, automation, and developer support — helping us shift from manual and reactive operations to predictive, self-optimizing infrastructure management.
The ideal candidate brings solid infrastructure engineering experience combined with practical knowledge of AI/ML integration. You are comfortable working with LLMs, ML pipelines, and AI automation frameworks, and you know how to apply them to real operational problems at scale. You thrive in environments that require both technical depth and the ability to experiment, iterate, and deliver.
If you're passionate about using AI to transform how infrastructure is built and operated — and want to be part of a team that is driving that transformation at a global gaming company — we'd love to hear from you.

lists.content:
• Design and implement AI/ML-powered solutions for infrastructure use cases, including predictive autoscaling, anomaly detection, intelligent cost optimization, and automated remediation across GCP and multi-cloud environments
  • Build and maintain AI-driven monitoring and observability systems that correlate logs, metrics, and traces to surface root causes, predict bottlenecks, and reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR)
  • Develop and operate automated incident response workflows using AI-powered playbooks that diagnose, contain, and resolve infrastructure issues with minimal manual intervention
  • Integrate AI tooling into CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment reliability, automate test prediction, score release health, and support rollback automation
  • Contribute to the development of internal AI agents and virtual assistants integrated into developer workflows (Slack, IDEs, Confluence) — enabling self-service for provisioning, troubleshooting, and infrastructure guidance
  • Implement AI/ML-based anomaly detection and automated vulnerability management workflows to enhance the security posture of Xsolla's infrastructure
  • Prototype and productionize Generative AI solutions for infrastructure automation, including auto-generation of Terraform/Puppet modules, IaC configurations, runbooks, and change documentation
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and leadership to evolve and execute the infrastructure AI strategy across its implementation phases
  • Maintain clear documentation of AI tools, integrations, and automated workflows; share knowledge and best practices across the team

• 5–7 years of experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, SRE, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience with GCP (priority) and/or AWS; solid understanding of cloud resource management, scaling, and cost structures
  • Practical experience building or integrating AI/ML-powered tools in an operational context (anomaly detection, predictive models, LLM-based automation, or similar)
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools — Terraform, Puppet, Ansible, or equivalent
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and AI/ML integration; Bash or Go a plus
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration in production environments
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, or similar)
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and prompt engineering for operational use cases
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a bias toward automation and eliminating toil
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal)

• Experience with AI workflow orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, n8n, or similar)
  • Exposure to AIOps platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog AI, Moogsoft, BigPanda, or similar)
  • Background in FinOps or AI-driven cloud cost optimization
  • Familiarity with vector databases (Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant) for knowledge retrieval systems
  • Experience with VMware or hybrid cloud environments
  • GCP and/or AWS cloud certifications
  • Prior experience in gaming, high-growth tech, or SaaS platform environments
  • The duties and responsibilities of this position may evolve over time to support the organization's goals and individual growth

• Design and implement AI/ML-powered solutions for infrastructure use cases, including predictive autoscaling, anomaly detection, intelligent cost optimization, and automated remediation across GCP and multi-cloud environments
  • Build and maintain AI-driven monitoring and observability systems that correlate logs, metrics, and traces to surface root causes, predict bottlenecks, and reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR)
  • Develop and operate automated incident response workflows using AI-powered playbooks that diagnose, contain, and resolve infrastructure issues with minimal manual intervention
  • Integrate AI tooling into CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment reliability, automate test prediction, score release health, and support rollback automation
  • Contribute to the development of internal AI agents and virtual assistants integrated into developer workflows (Slack, IDEs, Confluence) — enabling self-service for provisioning, troubleshooting, and infrastructure guidance
  • Implement AI/ML-based anomaly detection and automated vulnerability management workflows to enhance the security posture of Xsolla's infrastructure
  • Prototype and productionize Generative AI solutions for infrastructure automation, including auto-generation of Terraform/Puppet modules, IaC configurations, runbooks, and change documentation
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and leadership to evolve and execute the infrastructure AI strategy across its implementation phases
  • Maintain clear documentation of AI tools, integrations, and automated workflows; share knowledge and best practices across the team

• 5–7 years of experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, SRE, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience with GCP (priority) and/or AWS; solid understanding of cloud resource management, scaling, and cost structures
  • Practical experience building or integrating AI/ML-powered tools in an operational context (anomaly detection, predictive models, LLM-based automation, or similar)
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools — Terraform, Puppet, Ansible, or equivalent
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and AI/ML integration; Bash or Go a plus
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration in production environments
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, or similar)
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and prompt engineering for operational use cases
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a bias toward automation and eliminating toil
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal)
    •

  • Experience with AI workflow orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, n8n, or similar)

  • Background in FinOps or AI-driven cloud cost optimization
  • Familiarity with vector databases (Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant) for knowledge retrieval systems
  • Experience with VMware or hybrid cloud environments
  • GCP and/or AWS cloud certifications
  • Prior experience in gaming, high-growth tech, or SaaS platform environments

ABOUT YOU
You are a prototyping and AI expert who thinks in flows, experiments, and code — and who brings strong UI/UX skills to everything you build. You move fast: your first instinct when exploring a new idea is to open Claude Code or Cursor, not Figma. You build interactive, working prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools, and you use design craft to make them feel polished and production-ready.
 
You actively build AI-driven workflows (prompt → pipeline → result) and know how to ship things — working with engineers to take prototypes all the way to production. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and complex inputs, and you validate your work through real experiments and user feedback.
 
You have solid UI/UX foundations — you design clear flows, understand visual hierarchy, and can produce high-fidelity interfaces in Figma when needed. But your superpower is the ability to collapse the gap between idea and working product using AI and code.

lists.content:
AI-Assisted Prototyping & Vibe Coding

  • Build interactive prototypes and design explorations using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, v0, Framer, or similar) — reaching for code as your primary creative tool.

  • Design and prototype AI-assisted product solutions (agents, copilots, generation and automation tools) together with product and engineering.

  • Build and iterate prompt → flow → result pipelines; contribute reusable prompt patterns and workflow libraries.

  • Use no-/low-code tooling (Webflow, Retool, Zapier) where possible to reduce dependency on core engineering.

  • Move prototypes to production in close collaboration with engineers, ensuring smooth handoff and feasibility.

    • UI/UX Design

    • Turn ideas into clear UX flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity mock-ups in Figma when needed.

    • Bring strong visual and interaction design craft to everything you build — hierarchy, clarity, motion, and micro-interactions.

    • Create partner-facing materials: product presentations, landing pages, one-pagers, and infographics for go-to-market and integrations.

      • Discovery, Research & Experimentation

      • Contribute to discovery: interviews, JTBD, surveys, CJMs, and help translate insights into product decisions.

      • Validate solutions and hypotheses through quick tests and experiments.

      • Collaborate with analytics to define success metrics and interpret experiment results.

        • Monetization UX

        • Translate monetization and growth ideas into concrete prototypes, UX changes, and experiments.

        • Design and iterate flows for D2C, in-app/F2P, and LiveOps scenarios (shops, offers, bundles, events).

          • Bridge Business ↔ Design ↔ Tech

          • Translate business problems and partner needs into clear artifacts: flows, specs, clickable prototypes, and simple documentation.

          • Work closely with engineers to ensure feasibility and a smooth path from prototype to production.

          • Contribute to internal standards for AI-assisted workflows, UX quality, and visual consistency (without direct people-management).

• 5–7+ years in product design, UX/UI, or a hybrid design-engineering role.

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, v0, or similar) — you use these to build and prototype, not just explore ideas.

  • A genuine passion for vibe coding and AI-assisted prototyping; someone actively building this muscle, not just aware of it.

  • Confident in Figma for UX flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity design when required.

  • Proven AI production experience: building prompt + workflow pipelines and shipping automated or AI-assisted flows into real use.

  • Strong UI skills: visual clarity, hierarchy, attention to detail, and the ability to make prototypes feel polished.

  • Strong UX thinking: flows, structure, consistency, and edge cases — able to design connected product experiences, not just individual screens.

  • Research skills: experience contributing to discovery (interviews, JTBD, CJM), usability tests, and surveys.

  • Analytics & experiments: comfortable framing hypotheses, reading A/B-test results, and connecting UX changes to business metrics.

  • Strong written and verbal communication in English — able to align stakeholders around your solutions.

• Strong track record of designing and shipping D2C and F2P / in-app monetization experiences (shops, checkouts, promotions, LiveOps).

  • Experience in the gaming industry or working with game developers / publishers.

  • Ability to write functional front-end code (HTML/CSS/JS/React) to build prototypes independently.

  • Deep craft in interaction design, motion, and design systems; experience contributing to or maintaining a design system.

  • Broad understanding of modern product architecture (APIs, client–server patterns, microservices, cloud).

  • Experience with no-code / low-code tools such as Webflow, Retool, Zapier, or similar.

  • Experience in a fast-paced startup or scale-up environment.

  • Familiarity with growth design principles (conversion optimisation, funnel analysis, pricing presentation).

  • Additional language skills relevant to key markets (e.g. Russian, Malay, Chinese).

Software Engineering & Problem Solving:
  • Build and ship reliable, secure, and scalable backend systems.
  • Own implementation from design to deployment, ensuring maintainability and performance.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and offer informed technical input.
  • Refactor legacy codebases to improve structure and efficiency while maintaining feature
  • continuity.
  • Drive production readiness by handling incident response, root cause analysis, and
  • observability improvements.
    •  
    Technical Excellence:
  • Write clear, testable, and well-documented code, emphasizing quality and automation.
  • Contribute to a culture of engineering excellence through code reviews and design
  • discussions.
  • Advocate for sound software development practices and continuous improvement.
    • Collaboration & Impact:
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to align on objectives
  • and deliverables.
  • Contribute to technical scoping and estimation for features and infrastructure work.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve the developer experience.

• 6+ years of professional experience in software engineering.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Go (Golang) in production environments.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL and/or MySQL.
  • Proficient with containerization and orchestration tools: Docker, Kubernetes (K8s), and
  • Helm.
  • Familiarity with messaging systems like RabbitMQ or Kafka.
  • Comfortable using Git and CI/CD tooling in collaborative workflows.
  • Working knowledge of frontend technologies, especially React and/or Next.js.
  • Basic understanding of cloud platforms (GCP preferred).

• Experience building scalable, secure Login-as-a-Service platforms.
  • Deep knowledge of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT, and session/token management.
  • Strong grasp of social login, SSO, and federated identity.
  • Designed multi-tenant identity systems with isolation and configurability.
  • Delivered developer-friendly APIs, SDKs, and integration documentation.
  • Strong English communicator, for both technical and non-technical topics.

  • English proficiency at B2 level.

  • Experience with frontend development using any framework, preferably React.

descriptionBody:
ABOUT YOU

We are looking for a Backend Engineer who is curious, collaborative, and eager to grow in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting. The best candidate will be someone who is excited to develop and maintain scalable backend services that power innovative products used by game developers and players worldwide.

Strong programming skills in PHP and/or Golang are essential, along with a solid understanding of algorithms, database design, and software engineering principles. The ability to write clean, testable code while contributing to a team-oriented development environment will be key to your success in this role.

If you're passionate about building reliable backend systems and love working on products that empower the gaming industry, we would love to hear from you!

 
ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

descriptionPlain:
ABOUT YOU
 
We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer with a strong infrastructure mindset to join our Technology team. This role sits at the intersection of backend development and platform engineering, with Kubernetes as a first-class concern, not just a deployment target.
 
Our platform dynamically scales hundreds of servers daily, orchestrating isolated runtime environments inside Kubernetes pods. You’ll help design, build, and evolve the backend services and infrastructure systems that make this possible—focusing heavily on Infrastructure as Code, dynamic scaling, and reliability at scale.
 
If you enjoy working close to the metal (while still writing application code), thinking in systems, and solving problems where application behavior and infrastructure behavior are deeply intertwined, this role is for you.
 
 
ABOUT US
 
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world.
 
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

lists.content:
• Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js and TypeScript
  • Architect and evolve Infrastructure as Code (IaC) that drives dynamic Kubernetes scaling and orchestration
  • Build and maintain Docker-based deployment pipelines and runtime images
  • Design and optimize deployment and scaling strategies across many services and environments
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and DevOps to ensure systems are resilient, observable, and secure
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve system performance, reliability, and cost efficiency
  • Document infrastructure patterns, operational workflows, and best practices
  • Stay current with emerging tools and approaches in cloud infrastructure and backend systems

• Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including: Autoscaling and capacity management, Cluster-level behavior and lifecycle concerns, and Production debugging and incident response
  • Strong experience building and running Dockerized workloads
  • Proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript for backend services
  • Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)
  • Experience designing and operating scalable backend systems in production

• Coordinate the execution of strategic initiatives to ensure alignment with company objectives.
  • Act as a strategic advisor to the CEO, providing insights, proposing solutions, and assisting with decision-making.
  • Plan and direct all administrative, financial, and operational activities for the organization’s CEO.
  • Oversee and streamline agency operations and procedures.
  • Prepare and compile documents for board meetings, leadership meetings, and other executive needs.

• Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or related field, plus two (2) years of experience as an Executive Assistant or related occupation.

  • Corporate event planning and logistics: coordinating executive meetings, offsites, and company-wide events, including scheduling, vendor relations, budgeting, and execution logistics using Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Document and contract workflow systems: overseeing the execution and management of sensitive internal documents and contracts using tools like DocuSign, Dropbox, and SharePoint, ensuring version control, secure storage, and timely follow-ups.

• Define and execute the studio’s overall technology strategy and roadmap

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing engineering organization

  • Oversee the development and delivery of PC/console games from concept to launch

  • Ensure technical excellence, performance, and scalability across all projects

  • Collaborate closely with production, design, and art teams to align technical solutions with creative vision

• 10+ years of experience in game development

  • AAA project experience

  • Proven leadership experience managing senior engineering teams

  • Deep understanding of game engines, pipelines, and production workflows

  • Strong architectural and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration abilities

  • English native speaker

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience working on well-known or commercially successful PC titles

  • Background with Unreal Engine or proprietary engine development

  • Experience scaling teams and building technical culture in growing studios

  • Passion for high-quality, player-focused game experiences

Event Planning & Execution
  • Develop event timelines, checklists, and production schedules.
  • Assist in planning, logistics, and execution of in-person, virtual, and hybrid events.
  • Coordinate catering services, including menu planning, dietary accommodations, and delivery logistics.
  • Work with venue and third-party security teams to ensure safety protocols are in place and followed.

  • Strong organizational skills and keen attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency with event management platforms (e.g., Cvent, Splash, Hopin) and productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft Office).
  • Flexibility to work evenings or weekends when events require.

lists.content:
Marketplace & Homepage Ownership

  • Execute the content and placement plan across x.la and Xsolla Mall homepage and marketplace surfaces, as directed by Marketing, BD, and Product stakeholders.

  • Maintain the operational content programming roadmap, translating strategic priorities from Marketing, BD, and Product into actionable live-ops timelines.

  • Translate launches, campaigns, and partner initiatives into clear marketplace programming for execution.

  • Ensure alignment with leadership on priorities and trade-offs.

    • Content Operations & Live Ops

  • Manage day-to-day live operations across homepage tiles, featured placements, storefronts, and promotional modules.

  • Maintain content freshness, cadence, and quality across all marketplace surfaces.

  • Coordinate campaign launches and updates, including scheduling, QA, and go-live execution.

  • Work with stakeholders on a content calendar, planning out updates over time.

  • Work closely with Ops and Product teams to execute within existing CMS and tooling constraints.

  • Manage localization of landing pages and promotional assets with regional teams to ensure accurate and market-relevant content delivery.

    • Cross-Functional Coordination & Prioritization

  • Serve as the main point of contact for marketplace content execution requests from Marketing, BD, and other stakeholders.

  • Consult stakeholders to understand operational objectives, then own prioritization and sequencing of live-ops content.

  • Proactively flag conflicts, capacity risks, and trade-offs, ensuring leadership alignment.

    • Performance & Optimization

  • Provide operational tracking for live content, reporting on immediate performance indicators such as:

  • CTR and engagement

  • Platform health (freshness, utilization)

  • Partner with data and ops teams to ensure content performance dashboards are available and actionable for live-ops decisions.

  • Implement content and placement optimizations based on performance insights and marketing strategy.

  • Support experimentation efforts (e.g. placement testing, A/B tests where feasible).

    • Scaling & Enablement

  • Support x.la’s evolution into a scalable ecosystem of partner, brand, influencer, and creator storefront pages.

  • Help define templates, repeatable processes, and operating standards to support scale.

  • Normalize processes across x.la and Xsolla Mall where possible, adapting where necessary.

  • Provide structured feedback to ops and product teams on tooling gaps and improvement opportunities.

  • Build up a Content Calendar process to lay out a roadmap for content development

• 2–5 years of experience in content operations, digital merchandising, marketplace operations, or similar roles.

  • Experience managing homepage or platform content, content calendars, or live digital surfaces.

  • Demonstrated experience applying AI tools and agentic AI workflows (LLMs, AI agents, automation platforms) to content operations — not just familiarity, but practical integration into day-to-day work.

  • Ability to identify repetitive operational processes and design AI-driven automations (including autonomous or semi-autonomous agents) to improve speed, consistency, and scale.

  • Comfort working with evolving AI tooling; willingness to experiment with and iterate on AI agents and AI-assisted workflows.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple stakeholders and priorities.

  • Comfortable working in evolving systems and building processes where tools are still maturing.

  • Analytical mindset with experience using data to guide decisions.

  • Familiarity with CMS platforms, project tracking tools, and dashboards.

    • Nice to Have (AI Automation Skills)

  • Experience building agentic workflows using tools such as Claude, n8n, or similar platforms.

  • Familiarity with connecting AI tools to operational systems (CMS, project management, communication platforms) for end-to-end automation.

  • Track record of reducing manual operational overhead through AI-assisted processes.

• 1. Architecture & Development
  • Design, build, and optimize data pipelines and ETL workflows in Snowflake using Snowpark, Streams/Tasks, and Snowpipe.
  • Develop scalable data models, Algorithm supporting user 360 views, churn prediction, and recommendation engine inputs.
  • Lead integration across data sources: MySQL, BigQuery, Redis, Kafka, GCP Storage, and API Gateway.
  • Implement CI/CD for data pipelines using Git, dbt, and automated testing.
  • Define data quality checks and auditing pipelines for ingestion and transformation layers.
  • 2. Leadership & Collaboration
  • Mentor and guide junior data engineers on data modeling, performance tuning, and Snowflake best practices.
  • Partner with Data Science, ML, and Backend teams to productionize machine learning features in Snowflake.
  • Work closely with Legal, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure compliance, privacy, and governance of user data (PII).
  • Collaborate with the Director of Data Platforms and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • 3. Performance & Scalability
  • Tune algorithm performance.
  • Establish data partitioning, clustering, and materialized views for fast query execution.
  • Build dashboards and monitors for pipeline health, job success, and data latency metrics (e.g., via Looker, Tableau, or Snowsight).
  • 4. Governance & Best Practices
  • Establish and enforce naming conventions, data lineage, and metadata standards across schemas.
  • Lead code reviews, enforce documentation standards, and manage schema versioning.
  • Contribute to the company’s evolving data mesh and streaming architecture vision.

• 5+ years of experience in Data Scientist, with 3+ years in Spark framework.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with proven experience building ETL/ELT at scale.
  • Deep understanding of algorithm performance tuning, query optimization, and warehouse orchestration.
  • Experience with data pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, dbt, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (Kimball, Data Vault, or hybrid).
  • Proficiency in Kafka, GCP, or AWS for real-time or batch ingestion.
  • Familiarity with API-based data integration and microservice architectures.
  • Preferred
  • Experience lead machine learning teams or/and deploying ML feature pipelines.
  • Background in ad-tech, gaming, or e-commerce recommendation systems.
  • Familiarity with data contracts and feature stores (Feast, Tecton, or custom-built).
  • Experience managing small data engineering teams and setting technical direction
  • Strong ownership and ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication — can translate between engineering and business.
  • Hands-on problem solver who balances velocity with reliability.
  • Collaborative mentor who raises the bar for team quality and discipline

description:
About the Role

Xsolla is evolving its partner platform to support a growing portfolio of audience-specific products and experiences. This initiative is actively expanding, with new products and their dedicated entry points launching in phases throughout the year.

We are looking for a Delivery Manager to drive execution of this program and, once products go live, to own the operational coordination that keeps them running smoothly. This is a two-phase role. In the build phase, you will coordinate delivery across Product, Engineering, Design, and Marketing to ship on schedule. Post-launch, you will run the operational backbone that connects each product to the teams supporting it.

Reporting to the Business Accounts lead, this is a high-trust, high-visibility role at the center of one of Xsolla's core platform initiatives.

Responsibilities

Delivery & Launch Coordination

  • Own the delivery plan and timeline for the program rollout across an expanding set of products and their landing experiences;

  • Maintain a current dependency map across Product, Engineering, Design, and Marketing; identify and escalate risks and blockers before they affect delivery;

  • Coordinate cross-functional launch readiness for each new product release;

  • Track progress in Jira and keep delivery status accurate and current;

Stakeholder Communication & Meetings

  • Prepare and run recurring program meetings — distribute agendas in advance, capture action items, and follow them through to completion;

  • Publish a regular status update covering progress, upcoming launches, and active blockers;

  • Act as the primary point of contact for coordination questions across teams;

  • Maintain Confluence documentation for processes, decision logs, and launch playbooks;

Operational Coordination

  • Design and operate the collaboration framework connecting launched products with partner departments (Marketing, DevRel, Support, Product, Engineering) — intake, SLAs, escalation paths;

  • Operate the request intake and tracking system — receive needs, route to owners, monitor progress;

  • Run regular syncs with key contacts across departments and resolve or escalate blockers;

  • Build and maintain operational playbooks so the model scales cleanly as the portfolio grows;

Insights & Feedback Loop

  • Capture feedback from product teams and product owners, route actionable items, and close the loop;

  • Synthesize recurring themes into input for product prioritization;

  • Track delivery and operational metrics and surface friction across the partner journey.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of program, project, or delivery management experience in a technology or platform organization;

  • Demonstrated experience managing cross-team dependencies and stakeholder communication in a multi-team or multi-product environment;

  • Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for tracking, reporting, and documentation;

  • Strong written and verbal communication, with experience producing status updates, meeting materials, and operational documentation;

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and proactively identify and escalate issues;

  • Track record of establishing and improving operational processes;

  • Fluent English.

Nice to Have

  • Background in gaming, digital commerce, or platform-as-a-service environments;

  • Experience launching products or platforms from zero to one;

  • Familiarity with B2B SaaS, customer success, or partner-facing programs;

  • Experience working with distributed, async-first teams across multiple timezones.

About You

We're looking for an organized, detail-oriented, and eager-to-grow Account Coordinator to join the Xsolla Offerwall team. This is an exciting entry-to-mid level opportunity to build a career at the intersection of gaming, performance advertising, and partner success. The best candidate is someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and takes pride in keeping things running smoothly — from partner onboarding to day-to-day campaign management.

In this client-facing role, you'll support and manage a portfolio of affiliate and API-integrated demand partners, ensuring their campaigns are set up correctly, running efficiently, and delivering results. You'll work closely with senior account managers and cross-functional teams to support partner onboarding, troubleshoot integration issues, and maintain strong relationships with affiliate and API partners.

Strong organizational skills, a proactive mindset, and a willingness to dig into both data and technical details will be key to your success. If you're passionate about gaming and performance marketing and are excited to grow your career in ad tech, we'd love to hear from you!

 

 

About Us

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services designed to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla has helped over 1,500+ game developers reach more players and grow their businesses around the world.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

lists.content:
Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of affiliate and API-integrated demand partners running user acquisition campaigns on the Xsolla Offerwall, serving as their primary day-to-day point of contact.
  • Support the onboarding of new affiliate and API partners, coordinating with technical and operations teams to ensure integrations are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Maintain accurate records of partner accounts, campaign configurations, and integration statuses in CRM and internal tracking tools.
  • Monitor live campaigns across affiliate and API partners, flagging performance anomalies and working with internal teams to resolve discrepancies quickly.
  • Assist partners with technical questions related to API documentation, tracking setup, postback configuration, and feed integration.
  • Coordinate with the technical team to triage and resolve integration issues, acting as a clear communication bridge between partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Review campaign data regularly using KPIs such as CPI, CTR, conversion rate, and install volume to identify issues and surface optimization opportunities.
  • Prepare regular performance reports and campaign summaries for partners, translating data into clear, digestible updates.
  • Support senior account managers in preparing business reviews, renewal materials, and growth presentations for key accounts.
  • Respond to partner inquiries promptly and professionally, maintaining a high standard of service across all communications.

    •  

    Qualifications & Skills — Required

  • 1–2 years of experience in account management, partner support, digital advertising operations, or a related field; AdTech, affiliate marketing, or mobile advertising experience preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — clear, concise, and professional in all partner-facing interactions.
  • Comfortable working with campaign data and performance metrics such as CPI, CTR, install volume, and conversion rate, with the ability to spot trends, escalate issues, and summarize findings clearly.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail; able to manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Collaborative team player, comfortable working across product, operations, and technical teams.
  • Proficient in Google Sheets or Excel for tracking and reporting.
    •  

     

    Nice to Have

  • Exposure to affiliate networks, API integrations, or performance marketing platforms.
  • Basic familiarity with API concepts, tracking links, postback URLs, and affiliate/performance integrations — you don't need to be an engineer, but comfort reading technical documentation is a plus.
  • Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • A genuine interest in gaming, digital advertising, and the performance marketing ecosystem.

lists.content:
• Establish and maintain a strong presence in top game developer communities .
  • Represent Xsolla at developer conferences, meetups, and industry events .
  • Organize and participate in developer meetups, hackathons, and regional gatherings.
  • Produce high-quality technical and inspirational materials, including: Articles, blog posts, and tutorials. Videos, webcasts, and looms. Social media stories, posts, and developer updates.
  • Keep all content up to date and aligned with the latest product releases and best practices.
  • Collaborate with Developer Marketing to amplify content reach and engagement.
  • Act as a trusted liaison between developers and Xsolla’s Product/Technical teams.
  • Gather, organize, and share feedback from the community to help improve product features and documentation.
  • Identify opportunities for lighthouse integration cases and partner with internal teams to bring them to life.
  • Track and report on: Reach and engagement of produced content. Community participation and growth. Developer satisfaction with materials and events.
  • Use insights to refine outreach tactics and maximize impact.

• 3–5 years in Developer Advocacy, Community Management, or related roles, ideally in the game industry.
  • Technical background and software development experience.
  • Solid understanding of game development processes and tools (mobile, PC, and/or web).
  • Proven ability to produce engaging technical content across multiple formats.
  • Strong presence in online developer communities and comfort in public speaking.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and interpersonal skills.
  • Fluent in both Russian and English, with excellent written and spoken communication skills.
  • Ability to travel for partner visits, conferences, and training events - primarily across the CIS region.

lists.content:
• Lead hands-on developer sessions, integration walkthroughs, and partner workshops.
  • Provide technical guidance for both custom integration scenarios and self-service implementations.
  • Support partners in solving integration challenges quickly and effectively, acting as a trusted technical advisor.
  • Develop high-quality technical resources, including: Integration guides, step-by-step tutorials, and sample code. Demo projects, reference implementations, and API usage examples. Recorded video walk throughs, technical webinars, and training sessions.
  • Keep all resources up to date with the latest product features and integration best practices.
  • Work with Product and Developer Relations leadership to deliver lighthouse integration cases—top-tier implementations that showcase the full potential of Xsolla’s solutions.
  • Document and package these integrations as reusable templates and inspiration for other developers.
  • Represent Xsolla at industry events, technical conferences, and meetups.
  • Conduct technical presentations, live demos, and coding sessions that inspire confidence in Xsolla’s integration capabilities.
  • Collect and relay developer feedback on integration processes and tools to Product and Engineering teams.
  • Recommend improvements to SDKs, APIs, and documentation to streamline integration efforts.
  • Track and report on: Number and quality of integrations delivered or supported. Engagement with integration-focused resources. Conversion rates from technical enablement to live integrations.

• 3–5 years in Developer Advocacy, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Evangelism, ideally in the game industry.
  • Strong technical skills in game development and integration (e.g., Unity, Unreal, backend APIs, payment systems).
  • Experience delivering hands-on technical training, demos, and workshops.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and customer-focused mindset.
  • Comfort in public speaking and presenting technical content to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to travel for partner visits, conferences, and training events.

description:
About You

We're looking for an entrepreneurial commercial leader to build Xsolla's brand partnerships business from the ground up.

This is not a traditional sales role. We're seeking someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys creating new revenue streams, and has experience bringing innovative advertising, commerce, loyalty, identity, and consumer engagement products to market.

You will work at the intersection of gaming, commerce, advertising, identity, and consumer engagement to help leading brands connect with millions of gamers through Xsolla's ecosystem.

The ideal candidate has experience selling into brands, agencies, loyalty teams, media buyers, retail marketers, and commerce organizations. They understand how to translate product capabilities into compelling business outcomes and are comfortable helping define both go-to-market strategy and product direction.

This role will be responsible for establishing Xsolla's brand-side commercial motion, identifying early lighthouse customers, developing strategic partnerships, and helping shape the next generation of Xsolla advertising and consumer products.

If you're excited about building a new business rather than inheriting one, we'd love to hear from you.

 

 

About Us

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services designed to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games.

Today, Xsolla powers commerce, payments, rewards, advertising, loyalty, identity, and engagement experiences for game developers worldwide. As we expand our consumer platform capabilities, we see a significant opportunity to help brands engage gaming audiences through meaningful value exchange, loyalty, rewards, identity, and commerce experiences.

 

 
What You'll Own

Build Xsolla's Brand Commercial Business

  • Develop and execute Xsolla's brand-side commercial strategy.

  • Establish and scale a repeatable sales motion for brand partnerships.

  • Identify, prioritize, and close early lighthouse partnerships.

  • Build relationships with brands, agencies, loyalty platforms, retailers, and financial services companies.

  • Create scalable partnership frameworks that can grow into a global business.

Own Brand, Agency, Loyalty, and Consumer Partnerships

  • Serve as Xsolla's commercial leader for non-gaming and non-performance marketing demand partnerships.

  • Build relationships across brand marketing, media, CRM, loyalty, growth, and innovation teams.

  • Develop partnerships that drive value across Xsolla's advertising, rewards, identity, and commerce ecosystem.

  • Establish Xsolla as a strategic platform for brands seeking meaningful engagement with gaming audiences.

Influence Product Direction

  • Act as the voice of the market for products including:

    • Xsolla Ads

    • Xsolla Rewards

    • Xsolla ID

    • Xsolla Backpack

    • Xsolla Choice

    • Future audience, loyalty, and advertising products

  • Gather customer feedback and influence product roadmaps.

  • Help define packaging, positioning, pricing, and commercial models.

  • Partner with Product and Marketing teams to bring new solutions from concept to market.

Develop New Revenue Streams

  • Identify opportunities for:

    • Sponsored rewards

    • Brand-funded offers

    • Loyalty integrations

    • Audience targeting solutions

    • Identity-powered marketing products

    • Commerce and retail partnerships

  • Build business cases and commercial frameworks for new products and services.

Establish Measurement & Attribution Standards

  • Partner with Product, Data, and Marketing teams to define measurement frameworks for brand partners.

  • Develop brand lift, incrementality, attribution, engagement, and conversion methodologies that demonstrate partner value.

  • Help shape how Xsolla measures and communicates success for emerging brand-focused products.

Collaborate Across Xsolla

  • Partner closely with:

    • Global Business Development

    • Product Management

    • Marketing

    • Ads

    • Rewards

    • Identity

    • Commerce

    • Executive Leadership

  • Support strategic customer conversations and executive-level business development initiatives.

lists.content:
Qualifications & Skills

Required

  • 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, advertising sales, brand partnerships, retail media, commerce partnerships, or related commercial leadership roles.

  • Proven experience selling to Fortune 1000 brands, agencies, loyalty programs, retail media networks, or consumer marketing organizations.

  • Demonstrated success building a new business line, category, market, or commercial function from 0→1.

  • Track record of structuring and closing complex strategic partnerships.

  • Strong understanding of digital advertising, loyalty, identity, commerce, audience targeting, and measurement ecosystems.

  • Experience bringing emerging products to market and influencing product strategy.

  • Deep understanding of attribution, incrementality, brand lift, and marketing effectiveness measurement.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.

  • Ability to operate independently in highly entrepreneurial and ambiguous environments.

    • Preferred Experience

    • Existing senior relationships across major brands, agencies, loyalty platforms, retail media networks, or consumer technology companies.

    • Experience working within gaming, adtech, martech, fintech, loyalty, retail media, or commerce technology.

    • Experience launching new advertising, loyalty, audience, or identity products.

    • Familiarity with first-party data, customer identity, rewards, and personalization platforms.

    • Experience building and scaling commercial teams and partnership organizations.

      •  

       

      What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

      • Establish Xsolla's first dedicated brand partnership pipeline.

      • Secure flagship brand, agency, and loyalty partnerships.

      • Create repeatable positioning and commercial packaging for Xsolla's consumer-facing products.

      • Influence the roadmap of next-generation advertising, identity, rewards, and commerce offerings.

      • Develop measurable attribution and brand effectiveness frameworks for partners.

      • Build the foundation for a scalable brand-side revenue organization.

        •

lists.content:
• Lead and grow a high-performing, distributed team of data scientists, ML engineers, and data platform engineers.
  • Define and execute the data science and ad tech roadmap, advancing initiatives in user modeling, campaign optimization, targeting, and personalization.
  • Architect and manage ML pipelines and experimentation frameworks, including feature engineering, training pipelines, model serving, A/B testing, and causal inference systems.
  • Oversee real-time pipelines for ad events (e.g., impressions, clicks, conversions), enabling responsive attribution and performance optimization.
  • Collaborate with Product, Growth, and Marketing to develop audience scoring, LTV/churn models, and incrementality testing for media measurement and bidding efficiency.
  • Ensure scalable, privacy-compliant data infrastructure aligned with GDPR, CCPA, and ATT, including support for SKAdNetwork, CMPs, and identity frameworks.
  • Foster engineering excellence with a focus on reproducibility, model evaluation, observability, and model lifecycle management.
  • Drive a strong feedback loop between experimentation and business outcomes, translating data science insights into product and go-to-market wins.
  • Mentor engineers and scientists on career development, technical depth, and cross-functional leadership.

• 5+ years of experience in software/data engineering or applied data science, with 3+ years managing technical teams in ML, analytics, or ad tech domains.
  • Deep understanding of machine learning and statistical modeling, including regression, classification, causal inference, uplift modeling, and forecasting.
  • Hands-on experience with ML/data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Spark, Airflow, dbt, MLFlow, and feature stores.
  • Proven experience in architecting and deploying end-to-end ML systems into production (batch and real-time).
  • Knowledge of ad tech ecosystems, including campaign hierarchies, attribution models (multi-touch, view-through), and creative performance tracking.
  • Familiarity with audience management, segmentation, and personalization frameworks in programmatic or CRM marketing.
  • Experience with privacy-preserving measurement, including support for SKAdNetwork, GAID/IDFA deprecation, and consent systems.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. PhD is a plus.

lists.content: As an Event Manager, you will plan, manage, and execute high-impact events - including B2B conferences, trade shows, networking experiences, and speaking engagements - that elevate Xsolla’s brand within the games, tech, and software industries. You’ll work closely with the Director of Experiential Marketing and regional marketing teams to design and deliver events from concept to execution.

• Lead event strategy, logistics, and on-site execution for Xsolla’s North American and select global events.

  • Support Corporate Events and VIP Events at private venue in Sherman Oaks, CA

  • Manage merchandise inventory, ordering, and allocation for Americas 

  • Manage sponsorship deliverables and partnerships at industry events.

  • Source and negotiate with venues and vendors (booth builders, AV, creative production, hotels, etc.).

  • Maintain and track detailed budgets across multiple currencies and regions.

  • Collaborate with internal marketing teams to develop event-related campaigns, including landing pages, email marketing, and social media initiatives.

  • Create and manage event listings on the Xsolla website and registration platforms (e.g., Splash).

  • Partner with creative teams to brief and deliver event materials, graphics, and branded assets.

  • Coordinate speaking sessions, panel participation, and content development with internal stakeholders.

  • Develop pre-event briefings, on-site run-of-show documents, and post-event reports.

  • Track leads, analytics, and ROI for each event, ensuring timely processing within CRM systems.

  • Support new event research, sponsorship evaluations, and strategic recommendations for future activations.

  • Travel internationally as needed to oversee event delivery and represent Xsolla at global industry gatherings.

• 3+ years of experience in event management or experiential marketing, ideally within the gaming, tech, or software industry.

  • Proven ability to manage global events and understand regional nuances and budgets.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills - able to handle multiple simultaneous projects with precision.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills (written and verbal).

  • Creative problem-solver with the ability to make quick, informed decisions.

  • High attention to detail, quality, and brand alignment.

  • Proficiency with Google Workspace; experience with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence) is a plus.

  • Familiarity with event registration and marketing platforms such as Splash.

  • Ability to travel internationally and work flexible hours to support global time zones.

• Coordinate and manage the end-to-end budget and investment approval process, including request intake, documentation review, workflow routing, and final closure.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional stakeholders and senior management.

lists.content:
• Lead the cloud cost optimization strategy across GCP, AWS, and on-prem infrastructure, ensuring efficiency, transparency, and financial predictability
  • Analyze compute, storage, networking, and Kubernetes resource usage to identify actionable cost-saving opportunities without compromising performance or reliability
  • Build and maintain forecasting models, dashboards, and automated reporting that provide real-time visibility into cost drivers and trends across teams and services
  • Develop and implement tagging/labeling standards, budgeting processes, and governance policies to enable cross-organizational accountability
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Finance, and Product to guide workload placement, architecture decisions, and scaling strategies
  • Drive adoption of FinOps best practices including rightsizing, reservation planning, autoscaling optimizations, multi-cloud efficiency, and cost-effective storage strategies
  • Create and refine internal tooling, automation, and pipelines for cost monitoring, anomaly detection, and usage attribution across Kubernetes clusters, virtual machines and physical servers, located both in datacenters and cloud providers
  • Advocate for a cost-aware culture by training engineering teams, running FinOps reviews, and communicating insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Stay up to date with the latest cloud pricing models, vendor offerings, and industry trends to continuously evolve Xsolla’s FinOps maturity

• 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps roles with a strong focus on cost optimization
  • Hands-on experience with GCP (priority) and AWS; strong understanding of cloud pricing models, resource types, and cost management tooling
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes resource allocation, autoscaling, workload placement, and cost attribution in distributed environments
  • Proficiency with cloud cost tools (GCP Billing exports, BigQuery, AWS CUR, 3rd party cost monitoring tools (Kubecost, CloudHealth), cost monitoring features in observability tools, custom dashboards, etc.)
  • Strong analytical and data-engineering skills, able to build dashboards, SQL-based pipelines, and forecasting models
  • Experience driving cross-functional initiatives and influencing engineering, product, and finance stakeholders
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business-focused recommendations
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal)

• GCP and/or AWS cloud certifications (on Professional level, preferable)
  • Understanding of FinOps Framework practices or FinOps Certified Practitioner certification
  • Prior experience in gaming, high-growth tech, SaaS, or multi-cloud platform environments
  • Familiarity with chargeback/showback models, internal cost allocation systems, or multi-tenant architectureExperience with Terraform, Helm, or GitOps workflows in cost-related automation
  • Background in data analytics, cloud architecture, or financial modeling
  • The duties and responsibilities of this position may evolve over time to support the organization’s goals and individual growth

lists.content:
• Lead the cloud cost optimization strategy across GCP, AWS, and on-prem infrastructure, ensuring efficiency, transparency, and financial predictability
  • Analyze compute, storage, networking, and Kubernetes resource usage to identify actionable cost-saving opportunities without compromising performance or reliability
  • Build and maintain forecasting models, dashboards, and automated reporting that provide real-time visibility into cost drivers and trends across teams and services
  • Develop and implement tagging/labeling standards, budgeting processes, and governance policies to enable cross-organizational accountability
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Finance, and Product to guide workload placement, architecture decisions, and scaling strategies
  • Drive adoption of FinOps best practices including rightsizing, reservation planning, autoscaling optimizations, multi-cloud efficiency, and cost-effective storage strategies
  • Create and refine internal tooling, automation, and pipelines for cost monitoring, anomaly detection, and usage attribution across Kubernetes clusters, virtual machines and physical servers, located both in datacenters and cloud providers
  • Advocate for a cost-aware culture by training engineering teams, running FinOps reviews, and communicating insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Stay up to date with the latest cloud pricing models, vendor offerings, and industry trends to continuously evolve Xsolla’s FinOps maturity

• 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps roles with a strong focus on cost optimization
  • Hands-on experience with GCP (priority) and AWS; strong understanding of cloud pricing models, resource types, and cost management tooling
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes resource allocation, autoscaling, workload placement, and cost attribution in distributed environments
  • Proficiency with cloud cost tools (GCP Billing exports, BigQuery, AWS CUR, 3rd party cost monitoring tools (Kubecost, CloudHealth), cost monitoring features in observability tools, custom dashboards, etc.)
  • Strong analytical and data-engineering skills, able to build dashboards, SQL-based pipelines, and forecasting models
  • Experience driving cross-functional initiatives and influencing engineering, product, and finance stakeholders
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business-focused recommendations
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal)

• GCP and/or AWS cloud certifications (on Professional level, preferable)
  • Understanding of FinOps Framework practices or FinOps Certified Practitioner certification
  • Prior experience in gaming, high-growth tech, SaaS, or multi-cloud platform environments
  • Familiarity with chargeback/showback models, internal cost allocation systems, or multi-tenant architectureExperience with Terraform, Helm, or GitOps workflows in cost-related automation
  • Background in data analytics, cloud architecture, or financial modeling
  • The duties and responsibilities of this position may evolve over time to support the organization’s goals and individual growth

• Build and evolve scalable, high-performance web applications using React (or Vue) with Next.js for SSR and modern web delivery.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to translate complex monetization workflows into intuitive user experiences.
  • Optimize frontend performance, focusing on loading times, rendering speed, and bundle efficiency, especially in data-heavy dashboards.
  • Ensure cross-browser and multi-device compatibility while meeting accessibility (a11y) and usability standards.
  • Participate in code reviews, share best practices, and help maintain high engineering standards within the frontend team.
  • Work closely with DevOps to streamline CI/CD pipelines, improve deployment reliability, and enhance observability through metrics and monitoring tools.
  • Own features end-to-end requirement refinement, implementation, testing, and delivery.

• 3-5+ years of professional experience in frontend development using React or Vue (React + Next.js preferred).
  • Solid experience with Next.js (SSR, SSG, routing, API routes, caching, and performance optimization).
  • Strong skills in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript, with a good understanding of component architecture and design patterns.
  • Experience with modern tooling (Vite, Webpack, Babel) and UI frameworks (Tailwind CSS, styled-components, Vuetify).
  • Hands-on experience with state management systems (Redux, Vuex, Pinia, Context API, or React Query/SWR).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, and testing frameworks (Jest, RTL, Vue Test Utils).
  • Strong understanding of performance tuning, responsive design, and cross-platform development.
  • Proficiency in Figma for designing UI/UX layouts, components, and interactive prototypes.
  • Experience with Framer Motion for building high-quality animations and micro-interactions in React applications.
  • Excellent communication skills, proficiency in English for technical discussions and documentation.

• Experience with TypeScript-first environments. Exposure to micro-frontends, edge rendering, or PWAs.
  • Knowledge of animation frameworks (GSAP, Three.js) or advanced motion/interaction design.
  • Background in gaming, fintech, or high-load consumer platforms. Experience with analytics dashboards, virtualization libraries, or complex internal tools.
  • Familiarity feature flagging, AB testing, or Monetization systems.
  • Experience migrating legacy codebases or leading UI modernization projects.

lists.content:
• Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using PHP.
  • Build modern, responsive web interfaces using Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
  • Translate product designs and user stories into high-quality, functional features end-to-end.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code across the full stack.
  • Design and optimize database schemas and queries (MySQL/PostgreSQL).
  • Implement effective state management strategies and integrate frontend with REST/GraphQL APIs.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, bugs, and UX inconsistencies across the stack.
  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical planning.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers.
  • Contribute to planning, estimation, and delivery tracking of new features.

• 5+ years of professional experience in software development.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with PHP.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with React, and TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of modern PHP and experience working with frameworks like Yii.
  • Solid knowledge of JavaScript/ES6+, HTML5, CSS3, and Web APIs.
  • Experience designing and working with RESTful APIs.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and query optimization.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile collaboration tools.
  • Comfortable writing tests — unit, integration, and end-to-end (e.g., PHPUnit, Jest, Cypress).

• Familiarity with other PHP frameworks such as Laravel or Symfony.
  • Familiarity with design systems and scalable component architectures.
  • Experience integrating third-party services (payment gateways, SSO, OAuth2).
  • Understanding of caching strategies (Redis, Memcached) and queue systems.
  • Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).
  • Experience with SSR/SSG and hybrid rendering strategies in Next.js.
  • Experience with Headless CMS (e.g., Strapi, PayloadCMS, Contentful).
  • Experience working in distributed teams across time zones.
  • Strong communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
